xyz.context: Immutable copied minima[3],ranges[3],directions[3],rotationX[3],rotationY[3],shiftX/shiftY/zoom scalars;captured from current adapter fields at each original numeric operation time. No early dataInputs snapshot;legacy alias/repeated-option semantics retained.
xyz.rotation: Original two rotation rows and StatFunc.Radians;X/Y/Z scales and sign/order preserved. No perspective camera.
xyz.normalization: Existing XyzDataCore.NormalizeAxis only;((raw-min)/range-.5)*direction;explicit X-derived count;ragged/nonfinite propagation preserved.
xyz.payload: XyzGeometryData named vectors with copied names/vectors and break masks. ProjectNormalized:3 vectors of n. CutPlanes:6 vectors of n. Cage:2 vectors of11. Ticks:6 vectors,3*(CInt(tx(axis))+1) each. GridLines:12 vectors,3*(CInt(tx(axis))+1) by corresponding axis.
xyz.ticks: TickAxis[5]=rawStep,rawFirst,count,normalizedFirst,normalizedStep. Math.Floor substitutes same numeric Int;original Math.Round digits/failures retained. Windows labels CStr culture retained.
xyz.source: SourceOrdinals=0..n-1 only for data packet;geometry packets have empty observation ordinals. Chartpoint=ordinal+1 within each rendered series;group packing can differ from raw source. PhysicalWorksheetRow=NOT_AVAILABLE.

scatter.normalization: Unchanged ScatterMatrixDataCore.Normalize;Windows passes forced.1;no new normalization/correlation/regression algorithm.
scatter.statistics: Existing Core Matrix.CorrelationMatrixCore.Compute,StatFunc.Intercept/Slope reused;Windows lower-triangle p/upper-triangle r and formats unchanged.
scatter.payload: Values[n,p];CorrelationX/Y[p*p],i outer,j inner including diagonal;RegressionX/Y[p*(p-1)*3] with endpoint,endpoint,-100 order or original zero arrays when disabled. PanelColumns[k]=k\p;PanelRows[k]=k Mod p;row SourceOrdinals[0..n-1]. Diagonal anchors remain accepted normalized contract.
scatter.grid: GridPosition(i,p)=i*1/p;horizontal grids then vertical grids;native pair loop i outer,j inner skipping diagonal;variable order/duplicates preserved.

wire.payload: WireSeriesData copied X/Y,structural BreakMask,RingOrdinals,SampleOrdinals;sample=-1 for terminal break;not observation/worksheet identity.
wire.geometry: Sphere retains ringR=r*cos(phi) and original operation order;ellipsoid retains separate a/b semiaxes. Full diameters/2. Latitude rings exclude poles;longitude meridians -pi/2..pi/2. Closed latitude duplicate endpoints retained.
wire.shape: (Max(0,lat)+Max(1,lon))*(Max(12,pts)+2);one terminal break/ring;invalid<=0 dimensions return empty portable series and retain Windows no-draw guard.
wire.bounds: 6 scalars minX,maxX,minY,maxY,minZ,maxZ;negative dimensions retain reversed bounds;no new validation.
wire.context: Same frozen current scene minima/ranges/directions/rows/shifts/zoom as data/cage;new object property snapshot on each Draw. Color/name/native series order stay Windows.

copy_safety: All input vectors/matrices snapshotted before portable calculations;all mutable returned vectors/matrices/names/masks/ordinal arrays independent per read. Private per-call builder is ephemeral,not a shared reusable mutable calculator.
exception_policy: No new filtering/normalization/rejection or algorithm correction. Core argument/index/Math.Round behavior retained from numeric slice;Windows preallocation/ordered field commits preserve characterized partial failure state.
